note: CB-c2 (IDENTITY BREAK): a Go group prefix reaches a route only inside one function body (collect_routes_in's prefix_map), so a router handed to a function as a parameter, or stored on a struct field in another file, registers its routes WITHOUT the prefix. A function mounted twice (/api/v1, /api/v2) gets one ROUTE per mount; a register function no caller mounts keeps its local path.
